features.name: Steps of the Fey
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you teleport up to 30 feet; you choose a Joyful (frightens a nearby target) or Mournful (Disadvantage on attacks against you) effect. A number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus (per Long Rest).

features.name: Misty Escape
features.desc: As a Reaction when you take damage, you become Invisible and teleport up to 60 feet.

features.name: Beguiling Defenses
features.desc: You are immune to the Charmed condition; you can turn an attempt to charm you back on the charmer.

features.name: Beguiling Magic
features.desc: After you cast an Enchantment or Illusion spell of level 1 or higher, you can teleport as a Bonus Action (as with Misty Step).
